algorithm.title: ZAI Algorithm –
algorithm.subtitle: Our Core
algorithm.description: The ZAI Algorithm is the backbone of the platform's revenue-sharing model. Creators and entertainers upload content, while fans actively support it by contributing tokens. Instead of relying on passive views or abstract 'likes', every token contributed becomes part of an intelligent distribution engine.
algorithm.smartAutomationDesc: Powered by AI, the algorithm continuously learns and adapts based on evolving content and viewer behavior, ensuring accurate, performance-driven payouts.
algorithm.decentralizedFairnessDesc: With transparent rules and blockchain-backed validation, there's no central authority controlling who earns — it's meritocratic and trustless.
algorithm.userEmpowermentDesc: Every viewer becomes a potential earner. Every interaction, view, share and comment contributes to the economic engine.
algorithm.gamifiedParticipationDesc: The AI introduces strategic reward timing, interactive events, and contests to keep engagement high and the economy active.

faq.title: Common
faq.whatMakesDifferentAnswer: ZE23 is the first platform to combine AI-driven revenue sharing, fan-based monetization, and real-time engagement rewards into one seamless app. It empowers both creators and viewers to earn, not just participate. Unlike traditional social media, ZE23 distributes 90% of revenue directly to its users.
faq.howEarnTokensAnswer: Through the Mining Mechanism, content engagement, referring users, and interacting with creator tokens.
faq.whatMakesSecureAnswer: Blockchain-based identity verification, blockchain-powered revenue splits, and transparent smart contracts.
faq.whatAreCreatorTokensAnswer: Mini tokens creators can launch to monetize and build fan-based micro-economies.
faq.needToInvest: Do I need to invest to use the app?
faq.needToInvestAnswer: No, but to unlock full earning potential, users can engage with the ecosystem through staking and active participation.
faq.canAdvertise: Can I advertise as a brand?
faq.canAdvertiseAnswer: Yes, brands can utilize ZE23 for advertising, with payments integrated into the Z3 token ecosystem.
faq.availablePlatforms: Is the ZE23 app available on iOS and Android?
faq.availablePlatformsAnswer: Yes. The ZE23 app will be officially launched on both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store but first will be launched as beta version on iOS.
